candidates: CORPORAL PUNISHMENT- Corporal Punishment is administered only by the building principal, superintendent, or certified employee, in the form of swatting the buttocks with a paddle (one to four swats).
No corporal punishment will be given unless there is a certified staff member present to witness the act.
The superintendent and the parent/guardian are notified of the corporal punishment.
